name: ply-web
description: Cloudflare Worker for ply: the /v1 git API and the public /view repository viewer.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/absence-gate.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/absence-gate.test.ts test/option.test.ts test/absent.test.ts && node test/cf-bundle.js && PLY_WEB_BUNDLE_BUILT=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/worker.test.js test/public-worker.test.js test/canary-verdict.test.js && PLY_WEB_BUNDLE_BUILT=1 node --experimental-strip-types --import ./test/register-tsx.mjs --test test/write.test.ts test/rays.test.ts test/viewer.test.ts test/security.test.ts test/public.test.ts test/gitcache.test.ts test/mirror.test.ts test/pinned.test.ts test/hold-last.test.ts test/status.test.ts test/cd-slo.test.ts test/cd-policy.test.ts test/cd-ramp.test.ts test/cd-log.test.ts test/cd-pipeline.test.ts test/cd-reconcile.test.ts test/cd-classify.test.ts test/cd-telemetry.test.ts test/cd-cas.test.ts test/cd-preflight.test.ts test/worker-deploy.test.ts test/worker-entrypoints.test.ts test/cd-flags-smoke.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cf workers types && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cloudflare.json
scripts.lint: oxlint && oxlint --type-aware -A all -D typescript/switch-exhaustiveness-check src scripts
